summary: Six signals are resolved by three actual public profile checks and three reviewed associations to existing copies. The Waterloo 2021 canonical URL is repaired, but its recording signal remains open. Twenty original sources were already deferred; one further source was ledger-only. The queue is not an approved-source preservation count. No source-approval or release labels were promoted, no transcript produced, no private workspace searched, no outreach sent and no paid access used.

questions.title: Recover existing private interview work
questions.question: Is any transcript or diarized text already available for Riddick 2023, Waterloo Entrepreneurship and Impact 2023, Research Discovery Days 2023, or the 2017 Woods/Friesen presentation? Tell this maintainer where existing private work can be found, privately; otherwise say none known.
questions.recommended: Recover prior private work first; if none exists, begin with Riddick after agreeing a private staging location.
options: Existing private work exists; provide its location privately
None known; plan new private Riddick transcription
questions.blocks: Private recovery/transcription work for four talks; not public indexing of their known metadata

questions.title: Choose the next bounded work cycle
questions.question: Which outcome is worth the next maintenance cycle: usable interview/research text, or broader patent and company-press preservation?
questions.recommended: Readable text first: a 90-minute discovery/edition-review pass, then the private Riddick lane once Q1 is answered. No paid access or model spending is authorized by this estimate.
options: Pause new gathering; maintain current evidence only
questions.blocks: Reprioritization and starting a new production batch, not this completed triage

questions.title: Confirm or exclude the 2012 deck
questions.question: Is the September 25, 2012 Road to Revenue / Buying and Selling presentation uploaded by Increase A/S actually yours? It may be a namesake; the evidence does not establish attribution.
questions.recommended: Keep it quarantined and excluded from quotes, biography claims and style use. If it is not yours, explicitly reject it in the next reviewed source update.
options: Not mine; remove it from approved personal sources
questions.blocks: Any attribution or use of the deck as Steven Gregory Woods' work

questions.title: Organizer outreach
questions.question: If bounded public searching cannot find a recording, should we contact CS-CAN, Waterloo Mathematics or USask about the three missing-recording talks?
questions.recommended: No messages yet. Use public research first; Steven can approve individual unsent drafts and choose the sender/channel later.
options: Approve one draft at a time after reviewing sender/channel
questions.blocks: Sending the organizer drafts, not continuing ordinary public searching

questions.title: LinkedIn access boundary
questions.question: Should the LinkedIn record stay explicitly blocked, or will you provide a sanitized public-profile-only subset for private review? Do not place raw exports or private account data in a public branch.
questions.recommended: Leave blocked unless the public-profile content adds unique value. Employer/institutional sources already provide alternatives.
options: Leave blocked and use alternative public sources
Provide a sanitized public-only subset privately
questions.blocks: LinkedIn capture/review only; no other archive work

batches.title: Completed verification and copy-discovery fixes
batches.value: Six signals closed without producing or publishing new private material.
batches.effort: Completed in this triage cycle; no measured duration claimed
batches.next_action: Validate regenerated inventory; retain evidence and existing source approval states.
batches.stop_gate: Do not treat a text-only patent copy as drawings or a daily inventory render as an external check

batches.title: Identity guard before attribution
batches.value: Prevents namesake material entering the personal record.
batches.effort: User confirmation, then approximately 10-20 minutes to reconcile reviewed source metadata
batches.next_action: Await Q3; retain the quarantine and identity warning.
batches.stop_gate: No quotation, style extraction or biography attribution without primary identity evidence

batches.title: Recover private interview/talk transcripts
batches.value: Highest likely value for source-faithful first-person content; Riddick is the first candidate.
batches.effort: Recovery triage approximately 15-30 minutes once a private location is supplied; fresh processing and speaker review require a separate estimate after inspecting the roughly 85-minute Riddick recording
batches.next_action: Await Q1, then recover before retranscribing. This maintainer produces/reviews privately; the other Mac remains a consumer.
batches.stop_gate: No private filesystem sweep, transcription, paid model use or public transcript export is authorized by the triage

batches.title: Compare two locally available publication editions
batches.value: Existing SEI-hosted papers may avoid redundant downloads while preserving publication-version accuracy.
batches.effort: Approximately 20-45 minutes total for metadata/page/edition comparison; not a full scholarly review
batches.next_action: Match CORUM II and Software Architectural Transformation against their DOI/proceedings records; keep them supporting-only until verified.
batches.stop_gate: A matching title/authors is not proof of the exact proceedings edition

batches.title: Three core research-paper recovery leads
batches.value: More useful text than indiscriminate profile or patent coverage if the consumer's priority is research.
batches.effort: Approximately 45-90 minutes for a bounded public/author-repository search
batches.next_action: Look for permitted editions of plan matching, architecture tradeoff analysis and scenario-based architectural engineering; do not substitute similarly titled Spectra papers.
batches.stop_gate: Stop on paywall/access controls or uncertain edition; metadata-only is preferable to a false full-text claim

batches.title: Three recording or slides searches
batches.value: Clarifies whether historical talk listings can yield usable content.
batches.effort: At most 15-20 minutes per talk before reviewing whether outreach is worthwhile
batches.next_action: Use the repaired Waterloo event page, CS-CAN listing and USask 2003 entry as bounded leads; Q4 controls outreach only.
batches.stop_gate: No messages sent, and failure to find a recording is not proof it never existed

batches.title: Fifteen missing patent-text captures
batches.value: Good for completeness and inventor/company history; lower immediate value for personal speaking/writing material.
batches.effort: Approximately 2-4 hours for all fifteen with reviewed identity, content-only capture and provenance; begin with two, not all fifteen
batches.next_action: After Q2, capture two exact-number public patent pages, preserving co-inventors, application/grant versions and limitations.
batches.stop_gate: No paywall bypass or bulk promotion; text-only captures do not contain all diagrams or establish legal status

batches.title: Four selective company-history leads
batches.value: Potentially useful acquisition, startup-profile and Kinitos product context; original source statuses stay deferred/ledger-only.
batches.effort: Approximately 45-90 minutes for initial access/identity review, not guaranteed capture completion
batches.next_action: Prioritize TheStreet/eCommerceTimes acquisition coverage, the older startup profile and InfoWorld Kinitos article; review before promotion.
batches.stop_gate: Do not pay, bypass access controls, contact publishers or duplicate an equivalent approved source without a deliberate next step

batches.title: Fifteen lower-priority deferred sources
batches.value: Often redundant news, secondary profiles/funding databases or restricted case material; not an approved-source emergency.
batches.effort: No work scheduled; 15-minute usefulness/access check per candidate only when a concrete claim needs it
batches.next_action: Keep metadata and source-owned deferred labels. Revisit only for a specific coverage gap.
batches.stop_gate: No blanket fetching, subscriptions, purchases or treating all deferred records as preservation failures

batches.title: Book and editorial-preface references
batches.value: Retain citations; full-book republication and a short editorial are not automatically worth acquisition effort.
batches.next_action: Keep bibliographic links; seek a permitted author edition only if a specific consumer need justifies it.
batches.stop_gate: No book purchase, copyrighted full-text republication or model-training/style approval inferred

batches.title: LinkedIn remains blocked
batches.value: Optional completeness, not a blocker for the public record as a whole.
batches.effort: No work unless Q5 changes the direction
batches.next_action: Keep the blocked check honest; any user-provided raw export remains private.
batches.stop_gate: No authenticated scraping, cookies, account UI capture or public raw export

batches.title: Legacy welcome WAV
batches.value: Low incremental value until speaker identity and intended use are established.
batches.effort: Defer; approximately 10-20 minutes for private identity/duration review if later justified
batches.next_action: Retain the public file as bytes, not a verified Steven transcript or voice sample.
batches.stop_gate: Do not spend transcription/review effort or infer speaker identity from its filename
